messages.subject: For Chris Calio | Global affairs, government relations and strategic partnerships
messages.body:
Dear RTX Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Chris Calio, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

RTX operates across aerospace, advanced technology, government customers, international partnerships and highly regulated markets. That stakeholder environment closely matches the external leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior engagement across public institutions and complex operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder execution could support RTX internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to RTX.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
